# DataGoat datacenter / hosting ASN list (strict bot filtering only).

# One Autonomous System Number per line; blank lines and lines starting with
# `#` are ignored. This file is the source of truth: `npm run build:data`
# regenerates `src/data/lists.ts`. Do not edit the generated file by hand.
#
# At `bot_filter_level = strict`, a request whose request.cf.asn is listed here
# is dropped with `bot_reason = datacenter`. At `standard` the list is ignored.

# file when new ranges should be treated as datacenter traffic.
